connection.title: Connection label
connection.description: Label the statements are recorded under

dsn.title: Upstream DSN
dsn.description: The postgres:// URL to proxy with $VAR references expanded; empty reads GAVEL_DB_DSN then DATABASE_URL

env.title: DSN variable
env.description: Variable the command reads its DSN from; the upstream is read from it and the proxied DSN exported under it

maxStatements.title: Maximum statements
maxStatements.description: Most statements one capture stores before it is marked truncated

minDuration.title: Minimum duration
minDuration.description: Record statements that ran at least this long

params.title: Capture bind values
params.description: Keep bind parameter values which carry row data and may hold secrets

allowMutation.title: Allow mutation
allowMutation.description: Allow probes to change runtime settings

seam.title: Seam
seam.description: How the capture is armed (supported seams: [self agent proxy])

wait.title: Wait for agents
wait.description: Wait for a matching agent to connect
